text: You create a skill by writing a SKILL.md file with instructions, and Claude adds it to its available toolkit.
quote: Create a `SKILL.md` file with instructions, and Claude adds it to its toolkit.

text: Claude automatically decides when to use a matching skill, or you can invoke one explicitly with /skill-name.
quote: Claude uses skills when relevant, or you can invoke one directly with `/skill-name`.

text: Skill frontmatter lets you control whether the user or Claude invokes the skill, plus a directory for supporting files.
quote: Skills add optional features: a directory for supporting files, frontmatter to [control whether you or Claude invokes them]... and the ability for Claude to load them automatically when relevant.

text: A settings flag can disable all bundled skills except /doctor.
quote: the [`disableBundledSkills`](/docs/en/settings-reference#disablebundledskills) setting, which disables every bundled skill except `/doctor`.

text: Built-in /run and /verify commands infer how to launch your project from README, package.json, or Makefile with no setup.
quote: `/run` and `/verify` work without setup. They infer the launch from your project type (CLI, server, TUI, browser-driven) and from what's in your README, `package.json`, or `Makefile`.

text: Custom plugins can extend Claude Code with skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers bundled together.
quote: Create custom plugins to extend Claude Code with skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers.

text: Plugins are self-contained directories invoked as /plugin-name:hello, built for sharing with teammates, community distribution, and versioned releases.
quote: Plugins (self-contained directories with skills, agents, hooks, or a `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` manifest) | `/plugin-name:hello` | Sharing with teammates, distributing to community, versioned releases, reusable across projects

text: A plugin marketplace is a catalog for distributing plugins with centralized discovery.
quote: A **plugin marketplace** is a catalog that lets you distribute plugins to others. Marketplaces provide centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates

text: You can add a marketplace and install a specific plugin with one documented command.
quote: /plugin marketplace add ./my-marketplace /plugin install quality-review-plugin@my-plugins

text: Skills can be invoked via the API by specifying skill_id, type, and version in a container parameter, running in a code execution environment.
quote: You specify Skills in the `container` parameter with a `skill_id`, `type`, and optional `version`, and they run in the code execution environment.

text: Pre-built document skills are available by short name: pptx, xlsx, docx, pdf.
quote: Skill IDs | Short names: `pptx`, `xlsx`, `docx`, `pdf`

text: Skills can be made available to all users or kept private to your workspace.
quote: Availability | Available to all users | Private to your workspace

text: A dedicated skill exists for creating new skills and iteratively improving them.
quote: A skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them.

text: Skill tooling can benchmark performance with variance analysis and optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
quote: benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy

text: A bundled PDF skill lets Claude fill forms and manipulate PDFs directly, beyond its native reading ability.
quote: Claude already knows a lot about understanding PDFs, but is limited in its ability to manipulate them directly (e.g. to fill out a form). This PDF skill lets us give Claude these new abilities.

text: Skills can bundle extra files in their directory and reference them by name from SKILL.md.
quote: skills can bundle additional files within the skill directory and reference them by name from `SKILL.md`.

text: The required description field (1-1024 chars) must state both what the skill does and when to use it.
quote: The required `description` field: Must be 1-1024 characters, Should describe both what the skill does and when to use it

text: A verify-style workflow can build and run the app to confirm a change works, instead of relying only on tests or type checks.
quote: Build and run your app to confirm a code change does what it should, without falling back to tests or type checks

text: Up to 20 Skills can be included in a single Messages API request.
quote: Skills are specified using the `container` parameter in the Messages API. You can include up to 20 Skills for each request.

text: Skills can be uploaded and managed through a dedicated Skills API.
quote: Upload and manage through the [Skills API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/skills/create)

text: Claude loads a skill's full SKILL.md into context automatically when it judges the skill relevant to the task.
quote: If Claude thinks the skill is relevant to the current task, it will load the skill by reading its full `SKILL.md` into context.

text: A skill is fundamentally just a directory containing, at minimum, a SKILL.md file.
quote: A skill is a directory containing, at minimum, a `SKILL.md` file

text: A plugin manifest file (.claude-plugin/plugin.json) defines the plugin's name, description, and version for distribution.
quote: The manifest file at `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` defines your plugin's identity: its name, description, and version.

text: Skill templates prompt authors to write a description of what the skill does and when Claude should use it.
quote: Replace with description of the skill and when Claude should use it.

text: Example: a PDF skill's description states exactly what it does and when to trigger, e.g. on PDF mentions.
quote: description: Extracts text and tables from PDF files, fills PDF forms, and merges multiple PDFs. Use when working with PDF documents or when the user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction.

text: Plugin marketplaces provide version tracking, automatic updates, and support git repositories or local paths as sources.
quote: Marketplaces provide centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates, and support for multiple source types, including git repositories and local paths.

text: You can add a skill to a plugin and test it locally before distributing, using the --plugin-dir flag.
quote: add a skill, and test it locally using the \`--plugin-dir\` flag

text: Skills package your expertise into composable resources that turn general-purpose agents into specialized ones.
quote: Skills extend Claude’s capabilities by packaging your expertise into composable resources for Claude, transforming general-purpose agents into specialized agents that fit your needs.

text: Claude Code skills follow the open Agent Skills specification, portable across multiple AI tools.
quote: Claude Code skills follow the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) open standard, which works across multiple AI tools.

text: A guide documents how to use both pre-built and custom Skills through the Claude API.
quote: This guide shows you how to use both pre-built and custom Skills with the Claude API.

text: Skills are organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and load dynamically.
quote: organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and load dynamically to perform better at specific tasks

text: SKILL.md must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown instructions.
quote: The `SKILL.md` file must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown content.

text: Skill directories can include optional scripts/, references/, and assets/ subfolders.
quote:
scripts/          # Optional: executable code
references/       # Optional: documentation
assets/           # Optional: templates, resources

text: You can define a custom subagent when you repeatedly spawn the same kind of worker with identical instructions.
quote: Define a custom subagent when you keep spawning the same kind of worker with the same instructions.

text: An 'agent view' screen (claude agents) shows all background sessions in one place.
quote: Agent view, opened with `claude agents`, is one screen for all your background sessions

text: Agent teams let you coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together.
quote: Agent teams let you coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together.

text: Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through MCP.
quote: Claude Code can connect to hundreds of external tools and data sources through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)

text: Claude Code can be used as a library to build production AI agents.
quote: Build production AI agents with Claude Code as a library

text: You can register a GitHub repo as a Claude Code plugin marketplace with a single /plugin marketplace add command.
quote:
You can register this repository as a Claude Code Plugin marketplace by running the following command in Claude Code:

/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills

text: Skills are simple to create — just a folder with a SKILL.md file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions.
quote: Skills are simple to create - just a folder with a `SKILL.md` file containing YAML frontmatter and instructions.

text: You can install specific skill collections individually, like document-skills or example-skills, rather than everything at once.
quote:
/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills
/plugin install example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills

text: Instructions are provided for using existing skills from the repo or uploading your own custom skills.
quote: To use any skill from this repository or upload custom skills, follow the instructions in [Using skills in Claude]
